title: YaHS: yet another Hi-C scaffolding tool.

majorUnsupportedClaims: In the error-added simulated assembly, the relocation count for YaHS was incorrectly stated as 40; the reference indicates it was 42 (two more than the 40 of the error-free assembly).
minorUnsupportedClaims: Claim that a bioRxiv preprint exists with doi 10.1101/2022.06.09.495093 (not in the reference).
Error-correction threshold of 'one-tenth of the median coverage' is not supported by the reference.
Claim that YaHS is integrated into a 'production pipeline' and processes assemblies spanning multiple orders of magnitude is not in the reference.
Fabricated limitation that the evaluation lacks systematic characterization of high heterozygosity/extreme ploidy and that this was stated in the original publication.
model.rationale: The generated text contains a major unsupported claim: the relocation count for YaHS in the error-added assembly is given as 40, but the reference states it increased by two from the error-free 40, so the correct value is 42. This misrepresents a quantitative result. Minor unsupported claims include a fabricated bioRxiv DOI, an unsupported error-correction threshold, and an unsupported limitation statement.
